title: The otel adapter's /metrics carries the Python process and GC metrics beside kbmon's
goal: /metrics on loopback serves kbmon's metric points only (a registry of its own, not prometheus_client's global one), and answers 404 on any other path

run:
import os,re,shutil,subprocess as s,sys,time,urllib.request
U=shutil.which('uv') or sys.exit('uv is not on PATH')
pr=s.Popen([U,'run','--frozen','--project','otel','python','otel/kbmon_otel.py','--prometheus-port','0','--interval','1','--count','20','--panel','kb'],stdout=s.PIPE,stderr=s.PIPE,text=True,env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('OTEL_')})
try:
    url=None;t0=time.time()
    while time.time()-t0<120 and not url:
        line=pr.stdout.readline()
        if not line: sys.exit('adapter ended: '+pr.stderr.read()[-300:])
        m=re.search(r'http://127\.0\.0\.1:\d+/metrics',line);url=m[0] if m else None
    body='';t0=time.time()
    while time.time()-t0<60 and 'kbmon_' not in body:
        body=urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=10).read().decode('utf-8','replace');time.sleep(1)
finally:
    pr.terminate()
extra=sorted({l.split('{')[0].split()[0] for l in body.splitlines() if l and not l.startswith('#') and not l.startswith('kbmon_') and not l.startswith('target_info')})
if extra: print('/metrics carries more than kbmon metrics: %s'%extra[:5]);sys.exit(1)
print('ok: /metrics carries only kbmon metrics')

notes: SP-qvlnptiw review (ST-wi2volsz): the reviewer found the bind loopback-only (127.0.0.1 and [::1]; 0.0.0.0, :: and 127.1 refused).
